# Merrivale Stays - channel-manager configuration

`channel-manager` pushes rates and availability for the Merrivale cottage portfolio to the booking channels.

Two config layers apply: config/channel-manager.json is the production instance config and config/channel-defaults.json is the platform defaults. A key set in the instance config wins; any key the instance config does not set falls back to the defaults. A key in neither layer has no value at all.
